_comment: The hub declares its own orgs. This one declares the fixture's own 'test' Space -- the shape the shipped Example had before it became the Azure demo, slug azure-demo (#116) -- and the folder names the modules already read. Because it carries a 'name' it is a Space of its own, NOT a patch on the shipped one under its old slug (consts.json spaces.renamed), so the fixture keeps 'test' while config.default.json ships azure-demo beside it. 'status' is 'local' and 'example' true, the values the shipped Space used to lend it by merge, so no answer changed: a hub-declared 'active' would flip two Python suites into a live `az` probe.
